messages:
sara: Quick smoke run — Llama/Mistral/Qwen across eu-west1-h100 and us-west1-a100. Posting top-level p50/p95 and a couple anomalous logs.

ciara-bot: automated benchmark report: https://ci.internal/reports/1915004327 (summary + raw csv).

rhea: p50/p95 (tokens/sec / ms p95) from the short harness:
- h100 (eu): Qwen-Base-longctx (rope+GQA): p50 220t/s, p95 86ms
- a100 (us): Qwen-Base-longctx (rope+GQA): p50 190t/s, p95 132ms
- h100 (eu): Mistral-7B (default): p50 260t/s, p95 72ms
- a100 (us): Llama-2-7B: p50 210t/s, p95 110ms

dan: those p95 gaps are bigger than I'd expect between regions. Any kernel fallbacks in the logs?

sara: yes — saw several fallbacks on Qwen longctx where runtime printed: `kernel_fallback: unknown_rope_variant -> generic_gemm` around seq_len=4096. Pasted snippet below:

```
[2026-02-12T14:03:11Z] model=qwen-base gpu=h100 kernel_selector: attempted rope-gqa-optimized v2 -> not supported for block_size=128
[2026-02-12T14:03:11Z] model=qwen-base kernel_fallback: selected generic_gemm, perf_penalty=1.45
[2026-02-12T14:03:11Z] request.id=abc123 seq_len=4096 kv_cache_miss=true
```

rhea: repro steps: run `bench --model qwen-base --seq 4096 --gqa on --rope-version auto --region eu-west1` a few times and you'll hit it. Seems tied to block_size alignment and custom rope params.

eli: cc @dan — might be related to our kernel catalog not listing qwen's new rope layout for the h100 kernel variant. Did we backfill the kernel metadata for qwen-v2?

dan: I did the initial kernel probe but only for seq<=2048. If seq>2048 the selector falls through to generic path. Two mitigations: add a specialized kernel for 4096 blocks, or expand the selector to allow the hybrid-kernel for that architecture (checked perf — hybrid wins on h100).

rhea: small gotcha — when we tried quant4a on Qwen to save cost, latency improved on a100 but eval against the regression tests dropped by ~1.8% EM on our core NLU eval (flagged in the eval dashboard). So cost/perf tradeoff -> quality regression.

sara: can we do model-routing policy -> prefer h100 for Qwen longctx in Dedicated until kernel parity is added? That would avoid falling back in eu region.

dan: yes, config looks like: `route: if model==qwen and seq>=2048 -> prefer gpu_family:h100` I can push a canary to apply for 2% of traffic.

eli: add an eval gate: the canary should run the Evals harness on 1000 sample prompts and assert no >0.5% drop before ramp. If quantized variant used, also assert logprob deltas within threshold.

rhea: noted — I'll wire the eval harness. Also will add a short kernel test in the CI that runs `kernel_selector --model qwen --seq 4096 --block 128` to catch future regressions.

sara: cool. Action items: @dan add selector fix + canary policy, @rhea add eval gate + CI kernel test, @eli approve canary in the console once tests pass. I'll update the incident-lite doc with numbers. :thumbsup:

ciara-bot: created ticket RNW-3245 (runtime-kernel: qwen longctx selector) and RNW-3246 (policy canary + eval gate).
